items.question: For node2vec, what exact experimental result shows how much learning the search parameters p and q directly from data improves performance over using fixed hand-tuned values on complex networks?
items.why_unanswerable: The passage says node2vec performs best on complex networks when p and q are learned from data, but it does not report any numerical comparison or exact improvement against fixed values.
items.evidence_quote: While these search parameters have intuitive interpretations, we obtain best results on complex networks when we can learn them directly from data.

items.question: Which specific benchmark datasets did node2vec use to demonstrate that its node embeddings outperform popular heuristic scores for link prediction, and what were the exact scores?
